reasons.plausibility: Surface segregation of the lowest-melting-point element is a well-established phenomenon in multi-component alloys, making the proposed mechanism scientifically sound and convincing.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis can be clearly tested by in situ TEM/EDS and DSC on as-synthesized vs. pre-annealed nanoparticles, making the test both feasible and decisive.
reasons.usefulness: Clarifying the role of Cu surface segregation in initiating premelting directly addresses the original research question of defining the thermal stability and transition behavior of these nanoparticles.
